_doc: Music id -> MIDI file. LoadMidiFile (0x413e8c) looks the id up in the table @0x440dd8, then opens SOUNDS\<X><rest> where X='B' (base/AdLib set) or 'E' (extended/GM set, chosen from midimap.cfg) replaces the first letter of the stored name. Sector music id = 9504 + sector%6 for sector<30 (SelectSectorMusic 0x43200f); 9500 for sectors 30/31; 9501 closing; 9502/9503 sign-in/title.
